channel.title: RSJ Numerology Blog
channel.description: Vedic numerology insights — personality numbers, planetary energies, Mulank traits, and more by Rojal Svar Jain.

item.title: 3 Pillars of Vedic Numerology: Mulank, Bhagyank & Namank
item.description: Learn the 3 foundational pillars of Vedic Numerology — Mulank (birth number), Bhagyank (destiny number), and Namank (name number) — with calculation examples.

item.title: Mulank 1 — Personality Number 1: The Power of Sun
item.description: Mulank 1 is governed by the Sun. Discover the strengths, weaknesses, career paths, and mantra for people born on 1st, 10th, 19th, and 28th.

item.title: Mulank 3 — Personality Number 3: The Wisdom of Jupiter
item.description: Mulank 3 is governed by Jupiter (Guru/Brahaspati). Discover the strengths, weaknesses, career paths, and mantra for people born on 3rd, 12th, 21st, and 30th.

item.title: Mulank 5 — Personality Number 5: The Curious Mind of Mercury
item.description: Mulank 5 is governed by Mercury (Buddh). Discover the strengths, weaknesses, career paths, and mantra for people born on 5th, 14th, and 23rd.

item.title: Mulank 6 — Personality Number 6: The Grace of Venus
item.description: Mulank 6 is governed by Venus (Shukra). Discover the strengths, weaknesses, career paths, and mantra for people born on 6th, 15th, and 24th.

item.title: Mulank 8 — Personality Number 8: The Endurance of Saturn
item.description: Mulank 8 is governed by Saturn (Shani). Discover the strengths, weaknesses, career paths, and mantra for people born on 8th, 17th, and 26th.

item.title: Mulank 9 — Personality Number 9: The Fire of Mars
item.description: Mulank 9 is governed by Mars (Mangal). Discover the strengths, weaknesses, career paths, and mantra for people born on 9th, 18th, and 27th.

item.title: The Story of Rahu and Ketu: Shadow Planets of Vedic Numerology
item.description: The mythological tale of Samudra Manthan and how Rahu and Ketu — the shadow planets (Chaya Graha) — came to be. Their role in Vedic Numerology explained.

item.title: Childbirth Complications in Vedic Astrology Explained
item.description: Why do some babies have abnormal births? What role does Vedic astrology play in childbirth? Explore the astrological science behind pregnancy complications.
